groups.sentence: Universities offer sample syllabus statements and templates that range from prohibiting AI to permitting it freely.
Instructors choose one of the offered AI policy options or use levels for their course or individual assignments.
AI use is described in named tiers, from no AI, to limited or conditional use, to open or encouraged use.
Administrators develop a clear, consistent menu or tier system of AI use policies for instructors.
Instructors clearly state in the syllabus and assignments which AI uses are permitted, specifying an AI use category for each assignment or course.
Instructors may use icons, color labels, tables or scales to show the permitted AI level for each assignment.
Students are informed that each assignment states its AI level, from no AI to full AI collaboration.
Tier frameworks help instructors communicate to students what AI use is acceptable.
Students may use AI only for the limited tasks or conditions the instructor specifies.
Students may use AI freely or extensively where the policy is open.
Students must not use AI on assignments or assessments designated as no-AI.
Frameworks such as the AI Assessment Scale, traffic lights and numbered levels classify AI use, from none to full.
